title: Finish work late in Camellia or Rosehill? Harris Park cakes, pickup till 10pm
summary:
Camellia's industrial estate empties out around 6pm. Most Parramatta bakeries are already closed by then. Harris Park isn't - open until 10pm, seven days a week.

Every cake is 100% eggless. Not some cakes, every cake, since 2019. Custom design from a photo reference, 15 flavours including Rasmalai and Mango, six sizes from $39.99. 48 hours minimum notice - that's what fresh baking actually takes, not a delay.

Order via WhatsApp: +61 425 697 725. Pickup from Wigram Street, on the way home from Camellia or Rosehill.
